'''Star Tours Flight 521''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 2A at 1815 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1910.
